correctness.rationale: Every panhandle base has at most one tail entry. Exact stratum counts give Bernoulli tail occupancy with \(p=tr/(s-r+1+tr)\). Law of total covariance splits into two orthogonal within-block contrast projections and a rank-one bridge contribution. Its eigenvalues and multiplicities are obtained algebraically, with strict-order differences factored for the complete parameter domain and asymptotic constants obtained from the same rational functions. The exact-rational checker in the package constructs and diagonalizes via eigen-actions every covariance for 60 small triples and tests thousands of further inequalities. Experiments corroborate but do not replace the proof. Boundary \(r=s\) and integer eigenvalue coincidences explicitly covered.

value.rationale: This is the complete Euclidean covariance spectrum, including eigenvectors, multiplicities, strict smallest mode, and an exact all-parameter crossover, for a standard full-dimensional matroid polytope family. It reveals three separate order-of-magnitude variance scales and quadratic anisotropy in natural proportional rank limits, a structural distinction from isotropic uniform hypersimplex vertices. These are useful exact geometric second-moment invariants rather than isolated numerics, arbitrary slices, or recomputations of known Ehrhart data.
